Nathan Hagen graduated with a PhD degree
in optical sciences at the University of
Arizona in 2007, studying snapshot imaging
spectrometry and spectropolarimetry (includ-
ing CTIS). From 2007 to 2009, he worked as
a postdoc at Duke University, developing im-
aging and spectrometry techniques (includ-
ing CASSI). From 2009 to 2011 he worked
as a research scientist at Rice University,
